optional_items: Personal history for peer-only questions, additional evidence records and repeated panels receive no requested-answer bonus.
purpose: Review index for existing frozen scoring rules; does not alter scores, requirements, prompts or code.
required_answer_items: Each item in evaluator_only/rubrics.json includes its wording/shared-interpretation justification; both phrasings share identical items.

logging_and_measurement_caveats_visible.basis: Public interpretation rules require unknown logging, withheld release-time grades, and descriptive/noncausal interpretation. The renderer supplies these standard caveats equally; this flag does not credit the method with investigating them.

observation_status_visible.basis: The common public Action instructions require an observation_status panel; administrative eligibility and recorded activity must remain distinguishable.

source_validated_units_windows_counts_in.basis: Shared public rules require exact units, named windows/references, distinct people/contributing weeks and correct peer-mean interval labels. The common source integrity validator checks these independently.

semantic_review_limits: Historical broad activity wording does not identify one uniquely correct estimand. The revised interpretation is disclosed and provisional.
Supported comparison charts are accepted visual answer forms; external reviewers should judge whether numeric text should also be required.
Model-authored request maps and stopping claims are observable process records, not trusted gold coverage judgments.
The intervention combines task-state tracking with public phase reminders; this pilot cannot isolate their separate effects.
